text:
[Official TL] Otome Sekai no Arukikata is scheduled for release on Steam in 2027



In 21XX, radical feminism takes over Japan, turning the country into a matriarchy



Boys are separated from society at birth and kept in special camps, where they're trained to become soldiers



Yet one boy manages to escape that fate and live by hiding his true identity. He begins attending an all-girls academy and grows closer to its students, but his live remains in constant danger. Extremists seek the complete extermination of men, and some of his new friends hold similar beliefs



Story: NYAON (Otome * Domain)

Art: mignon (Hoshizora no Babylon)

Developer: Orthros (Zwei Trigger)



It will be available in English and Chinese
